long_biography.plain_text:
Boxing gloves first drew Roger Samuelsson towards Taiwan's manufacturing base. While studying engineering in Sweden, he traced their origin, visited local factories and began exporting Taiwanese goods. He later settled on the island and co-founded Scandinavian Health Limited as a trading company.

Samuelsson eventually bought out his partner and brought device design together with automated tooling, moulding and assembly. Demand increased as injectable medicines moved from clinics into patients' homes, pushing SHL towards reliable self-use devices. Its autoinjectors allow patients to administer complex prescribed medicines without relying on clinical settings.
long_biography.html:
Boxing gloves first drew Roger Samuelsson towards Taiwan's manufacturing base. While studying engineering in Sweden, he traced their origin, visited local factories and began exporting Taiwanese goods. He later settled on the island and co-founded Scandinavian Health Limited as a trading company.

Samuelsson eventually bought out his partner and brought device design together with automated tooling, moulding and assembly. Demand increased as injectable medicines moved from clinics into patients' homes, pushing SHL towards reliable self-use devices. Its autoinjectors allow patients to administer complex prescribed medicines without relying on clinical settings.
